initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a provenance handoff fault. The upstream provenance function is expected to output evidence_sources with record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank while preserving the retained demand record identities. Instead, assemble_provenance writes record_id from source_id, producing evidence source records keyed as s01..s08 rather than n06-r01..n06-r08. Job 2 then consumes those handoffs exactly and cannot match provenance ranks to coverage record_ids, so every priority row has upstream_rank 0.

terminal_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a fault in the upstream provenance handoff. Job 2 received needs with record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08, but evidence_sources with record_id values s01 through s08. The downstream prioritize function builds ranks by evidence_sources.record_id and looks them up by coverage.record_id, so every upstream_rank becomes 0. The supplied upstream source localizes the mismatch to assemble_provenance, which writes record_id from source_id instead of preserving the original demand record_id.
